profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer (VP) at Nomura
profile.summary:
Principal / VP Software Engineer specializing in high-performance, ultra-low latency Java platforms and large-scale platform transformation.

Currently at Nomura, delivering a mission-critical, ultra-low latency rates execution platform. I apply deep expertise in GC-free Java (17/21) and sequencer design patterns to enhance feature delivery and resilience — all while maintaining sub-millisecond latencies.

I’m passionate about turning technical strategy into measurable business outcomes. A proven leader in DevOps transformation and SRE enablement, I’ve:
- Led a full Kubernetes (EKS/FluxCD) migration at Landbay, achieving zero operational downtime, cutting infrastructure costs, and implementing a robust GitOps pipeline for faster, safer delivery.
- Automated complex deployment workflows, reducing release time from days to minutes.
- Modernized a core sports betting trading platform, re-architecting it into scalable Java microservices with Kafka for high-throughput, low-latency data processing.

Certified CKA, with deep experience in AWS, Terraform, TDD, and pipeline automation — always driving toward reliability, performance, and continuous delivery at scale.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a principal engineer at Landbay I lead a small team of front and backend engineers, where I encourage close collaboration with our PO and strive for simple, supportable, and elegant but pragmatic solutions to problems.
- Responsible for the technical design and implementation of product features.
- Working closely with CTO and architect guild to balance company-wide tech initiatives with product roadmap prioritisation.
- Very hands on with a majority focus on coding elegant Spring Boot applications.
- Strong focus on improving performance, stability, and observability across the platform.
- Continuously improving processes and code quality.
- Line management and mentoring responsibilities.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
As a developer within the Trading Products division I am closely involved in the design and development of new products that sit outside of the companies core architecture stack in order to explore new technologies and better system design. My close-knit team works collaboratively on projects without direct supervision, with the team taking collective responsibility for and ownership of the work we produce.

Core skills gained through my current position include:
●	J2EE Java development using Maven, Spring and Mybatis
●	Code and project management tools including Git, Artifactory and Jenkins
●	Front-end development using Javascript, jQuery, HTML5 and CSS3
●	Backend application and scripting development in TCL
●	Test driven development with JUnit and Mockito
●	Producing database schema designs
●	Writing Informix SQL scripts and stored procedures
●	Strong commercial awareness of the value proposition of the products produced
●	Adapting quickly to changing requirements within an Agile development process
●	Experience of SCRUM and Kanban development practices
●	Strong emphasis on Linux and command line tools

positions.title: Problem Analyst
positions.description:
Working within an ITIL compliant process to meet strict SLA’s.
Providing first, second and third line support to an international customer base as part of a distributed global support team.
Diagnosing and troubleshooting client issues and providing technical solutions in the form of code fixes, bash and SQL scripts and database diagnostics.
Working remotely on client environments to debug live issues through the capture and analysis of logs and monitoring and querying of databases.
Proactive identification and resolution of bugs and defects in live systems.

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer
positions.description:
Providing first, second and third line support to business clients as part of a global support team.
Diagnosing and troubleshooting client issues and providing solutions or escalating to the relevant team.
Developing and maintaining in-house support tools.
